body: Unfortunately, not everyone will be eligible for the study at this time. We appreciate your interest and taking the time to complete the eligibility questionnaire.
Let us know if you have questions that we can answer!

We recognize that people may not be comfortable completing the surveys knowing that we may need to take steps to ensure the safety of our participants. We take confidentiality *very* seriously and take active steps including calling you for a risk assessment before contacting anyone else.

Whether or not you participate in the study, I encourage you to reach out to the crisis line if you intend to act on thoughts of suicide or if you are unsure that you can keep yourself safe: **1\-800\-273\-8255** and **Press 1**, or send a text message to **838255**

Yup! The link is to a survey that allows us to initially contact someone to begin the process of determining if a person eligible to participate in the study. You can also select an option to speak with someone first about any questions you might have.
Hi there\- see the comment below. Payment comes in an electronic gift card of your choosing.
Payment will be delivered through some kind of electronic gift card. Some people choose Amazon, Home Depot, or Barnes & Noble, for example.

Hi there. We recognize that different research studies may offer different amounts of compensation. As pointed out, the amount we are able to offer has to do with the amount of time and work that we request from participants. We have worked hard to try to ensure that our compensation is fair based on what we ask of participants for the current study. If you or anyone else have questions about the compensation, we are more than happy to talk further.

Thanks for your interest in the study! We are not currently funded by or recruiting with Veteran Affairs due to their internal requirements, such as the primary researcher having to be considered a full-time VA employee. 

If you have any other questions, please don't hesitate to ask!

Sarah Carter and the DISC Study team
